proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: in the groupoid diagram of 02YE the top commutativity gives pr_0-sharp t-sharp(f) = c-sharp t-sharp(f); the norm construction is compatible with the right lower cartesian square, so pushing the norm of t(f) along s equals the norm along pr_1 of c-sharp t(f), while pushing along t equals the norm along pr_1 of pr_0-sharp t(f); the first equality makes these two norms equal, which says exactly that s-sharp and t-sharp agree on the norm, i.e. the norm lies in C (source lines 4477-4504)
